expected.ticket: Hi, I think I was charged twice for my November box. I see two payments on my bank app.

rows.draft:
Hi there! The extra charge you’re seeing is most likely a pending authorization from a failed payment attempt. Those pending amounts aren’t actual charges and will disappear from your bank statement within five business days. To confirm which payments are real, just go to Settings → Billing → Invoices in the Brewly app—only the listed items are actual charges. Let us know if anything looks different after that time.  

Source: [KB-02]

expected.ticket: My card expired last week, how do I replace the payment card on my account?

rows.draft:
Hi there! To update your expired card, simply go to **Settings > Billing > Payment method** and select **Replace card**. Once you add the new card, it will be used for your next renewal. Any payments that failed will be retried automatically after three days. Let us know if you need any more help!  

Source: [KB-01]

expected.ticket: I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives.

rows.draft:
Hi there! To reset your password, go to the login screen, tap **Forgot password**, and enter the email address linked to your Brewly account. A reset link will be sent to you and will stay valid for 30 minutes. If you don’t see the email right away, please check your spam or junk folder—it sometimes lands there. Let us know if you still have trouble.  

Source: [KB-03]

expected.ticket: Lost my phone so I can't get the 2FA code. I do have backup codes somewhere, what now?

rows.draft:
Hi there! Since you still have your backup codes, simply enter one of those codes to log in—each code works only once. Once you’re in, head to **Settings > Security** and set up two‑factor authentication on your new phone. Let us know if you run into any trouble!  

Source: [KB-04]

expected.ticket: How can I change the email address I use to log in?

rows.draft:
Hi there! To update the email you use to log in, just follow these steps:

1. Open **Settings** in your account.  
2. Select **Profile**, then **Email**.  
3. Type in your new email address.  
4. Check your inbox for the verification email we’ll send and click the link.

Your login email will switch to the new address once you’ve confirmed the link. If you run into any issues, feel free to let us know!

Source: [KB-05]

expected.ticket: The app just shows a blank white screen since yesterday's update.

rows.draft:
Hi there! Sorry you’re seeing a blank screen. Please try these steps:

1. Update the Brewly app to the latest version.  
2. Go to Settings → Storage, tap **Clear cache**, then restart your phone.  

If you’re accessing Brewly on the web, open a private/incognito window to see if an extension is causing the issue. Let us know how it goes!  

Source: [KB-06]

expected.ticket: My favourites saved on my phone don't show up on my tablet. Sync broken?

rows.draft:
Hi there! To get your favourites to appear on both devices, make sure you’re signed into the same Brewly account on your phone and tablet. Then, open the Orders screen on the tablet and pull down to trigger a manual sync. Keep in mind that syncing may take up to 2 minutes when you’re on mobile data. Let us know if you still see a difference after that.  

Source: [KB-07]

expected.ticket: Where is my order? The tracking link has shown nothing for a day.

rows.draft:
Hi there! Your tracking link can be found in the dispatch email or under Orders → Track. After we dispatch an order, the tracking info may take up to 24 hours to show any movement, so a day without updates is normal. Once it does appear, deliveries typically arrive within 2 to 4 business days. If you still don’t see activity after that window, feel free to let us know.  

Source: [KB-08]

expected.ticket: I'm moving next week. Can I change the delivery address for my next order?

rows.draft:
Hi there! You can update the delivery address for your upcoming order by going to **Orders > Edit** in the app. Just make the change before the order is dispatched. If the order has already been dispatched, the address can’t be edited—simply reach out to the courier using the tracking link provided. Let us know if you need any more help!  

Source: [KB-09]

expected.ticket: Would love a decaf option in the subscription! Any plans?

rows.draft:
Hi there!

Thanks for sharing your idea about adding a decaf option to our subscription. We log every request and the product team reviews them each month. If a request gains enough interest, it can show up on our public roadmap at brewly.example/roadmap.

We appreciate your input!

Source: [KB-10]

expected.ticket: Could you add dark mode to the app? My eyes would thank you.

rows.draft:
Hi there! Thanks for sharing the dark‑mode idea with us. We’ve logged your request and it will be reviewed by our product team during their monthly review. If it gains enough interest, it could show up on our public roadmap at brewly.example/roadmap. We appreciate your feedback!  

Source: [KB-10]

expected.ticket: Payment failed this month but my card is fine. Will it retry or do I need to update the card?

rows.draft:
Hi there! When a payment fails, Brewly automatically retries it after 3 days. If the retry still doesn’t go through, you can update your card by going to **Settings > Billing > Payment method** and selecting **Replace card**. The new card will be used for your next renewal. Let us know if you need any help with the steps!  

Source: [KB-01]

expected.ticket: The password reset link says it has expired, I clicked it about an hour later.

rows.draft:
Hi there! The reset link only stays active for 30 minutes, so clicking it after an hour will show it as expired. Please return to the login screen, tap **Forgot password**, and enter your account email again to receive a fresh link. If you don’t see the new email right away, be sure to check your spam folder.  

Source: [KB-03]

expected.ticket: Orders I placed on the website aren't syncing to the mobile app.

rows.draft:
Hi there! To get your website orders to appear in the app, make sure you’re signed in with the same Brewly account on both devices. Then, open the Orders screen in the app and pull down to trigger a manual sync. Keep in mind that syncing over mobile data may take up to 2 minutes. Let us know if you still see a delay!  

Source: [KB-07]
